experiment: Cross-seed x calibration-grouping robustness of FR vs FC four-layer GPTQ PPL
grouping_policy: calibration-only: sorted 217-row union, default_rng(seed).permutation, consecutive batches of 8 (27 x 8 + 1); NO evaluation / held-out rows; same grouping for FR and FC (applied to each seed's own union U_s; groupings nested within seeds)
reconstruction: E3 held-out relative expert reconstruction on ~/moe_cache test rows 2128-2255 (eval_cache_dir), identical for every configuration

determinism_controls.execution_order: every new (s,g) cache rebuilt with reversed batch execution order must match bitwise
determinism_controls.repeat_quant: seed-0 FR G20261111 re-quantized in a fresh process from the reused cache must equal the reused weights sha256 and PPL exactly

uncertainty_levels.window_bootstrap: evaluation-text sampling uncertainty CONDITIONAL on one fixed pair of quantized models (s, g)
uncertainty_levels.grouping_replication: sensitivity to calibration execution conditions (BF16 batch membership) within a seed
uncertainty_levels.allocation_seeds: variation in the selected calibration sets (only 3 seeds: outer unit)
uncertainty_levels.combination: not combined into a single interval; the hierarchical bootstrap covers seeds and groupings only, with the evaluation windows held fixed

decision_rule.quantities: Delta[s,g] = PPL(FC,s,g) - PPL(FR,s,g) for s in {0,1,2}, g in 5 grouping seeds (all 15, none excluded); m_s = mean_g Delta[s,g]; sd_s = SD_g (ddof 1); se_s = sd_s/sqrt(5); W = pooled within-seed SD = sqrt(mean_s sd_s^2); M = mean_s m_s; SB = SD_s(m_s) (ddof 1); EXP = W/sqrt(5)
decision_rule.RUN-BLOCKED: any of the 30 configurations missing or invalid, a cache / determinism / reuse-integrity check fails, or the seed-0 reused results do not match their frozen artifacts
decision_rule.ALLOCATION-SEED-DEPENDENT: (a) conflicting confident directions: some m_s > 2 se_s AND some m_t < -2 se_t; OR (b) material scale disagreement: SB >= 2 EXP (seed means spread at least twice what grouping averaging alone predicts) AND max_s |m_s| >= W
decision_rule.GROUPING-VARIATION-DOMINATES: (checked after seed dependence) |M| < 0.5 W AND at least 1/3 of the 15 Delta[s,g] have sign opposite to sign(M)
decision_rule.FC-PPL-PENALTY-ROBUST: all m_s > 0 AND in every seed >= 3/5 groupings FC worse AND M >= 0.5 W
decision_rule.FC-PPL-ADVANTAGE-EXPLORATORY: all m_s < 0 AND in every seed >= 3/5 groupings FC better AND -M >= 0.5 W
decision_rule.precedence: RUN-BLOCKED > ALLOCATION-SEED-DEPENDENT > GROUPING-VARIATION-DOMINATES > FC-PPL-PENALTY-ROBUST / FC-PPL-ADVANTAGE-EXPLORATORY > fallback

environment.note: determinism settings are recorded, not changed (changing them would change ORIGINAL numerics)

hard_constraints: no re-selection, seeds 0/1/2 only, 5 grouping seeds only, same policy, B=128, 4 layers, frozen GPTQ / precision / windows / batching, no test rows, no extension after results
